_meta.purpose: Realistic WO templates seeded from public ATA / MMEL / AD / line-maintenance sources for Boeing 737 narrow-body MRO operations. Mirror dataset to A32x workorders_real.json — same schema, B737-specific systems and ADs.
_meta.generationMethod: Per-chapter quotas weighted by real B737 line/base maintenance frequency. Severity calibrated to ~70% Minor / 25% Major / 5% Critical. Deferrable rate calibrated to ~35% (matches MMEL practice). Engine-specific WOs (CFM56-7B / LEAP-1B) tagged in chapters 71-80 where applicable. AD-driven WOs included for: pickle fork (NG, AD 2019-20-08), MAX 9 door plug (AD 2024-02-51), MCAS / AOA sensor (AD 2018-23-51 superseded), fuel tank wiring (SFAR 88 / FRM CDCCL).
sources: FAA MMEL B-737 MAX Rev 6 (2024-04-23 draft) — https://www.faa.gov/aircraft/draft_docs/mmel/MMEL_B-737_MAX_Rev_6_Draft
FAA AD 2019-20-08 (B737 NG pickle fork outboard chord crack inspection)
FAA AD 2024-02-51 (B737-9 MAX mid-exit door plug inspection)
FAA AD 2018-23-51 / FAA Boeing 737 MAX RTS Summary 2020 (MCAS / AOA disagree)
NTSB Recommendation 2025-06-18 / FAA memo on LEAP-1B Load Reduction Device (LRD) and bleed air smoke
SFAR 88 / 14 CFR Part 26 Subpart D — fuel tank flammability reduction CDCCL
Aviation Maintenance Magazine — B737 NG pickle fork cracking issue
b737.org.uk technical articles (hydraulics, fuel, landing gear, MCAS) — Chris Brady
SKYbrary technical articles by ATA chapter
transglobaltraining.com / studyaircrafts.com — B737 hydraulic A/B/standby system overview
AviationHunt B737 / B737 MAX MEL items reference
_meta.schemaNotes: engineSpecific: null when applicable to all engine variants; otherwise CFM56-7B (B737 NG) or LEAP-1B (B737 MAX). melCategory: null for non-deferrable items. Part numbers use placeholders (P/N CFM-XXX-XXXX, P/N LEAP-XXX-XXXX, P/N BA-737-XXXXX) — never real OEM P/Ns. Hydraulic terminology is System A / System B / Standby (not Green/Yellow/Blue).

templates.title: A-Check task card 200 — flight control surface visual inspection
templates.description: Per AMM 05-20 A-Check package: visual inspection of all primary flight control surfaces (ailerons, elevators, rudder, T/E flaps, L/E slats, spoilers) for cracks, dents, paint damage, hinge wear. Document findings in tech log.

templates.title: A-Check task card 305 — landing gear walk-around inspection
templates.description: Detailed visual of MLG/NLG: tire wear and pressure, brake wear pin extension, oleo extension, no leaks at retract actuator and door uplock. Sign off task card.

templates.title: Daily Check — log book review and deferred item status check
templates.description: Review aircraft tech log, BITE messages from CDS, MEL deferred items list and confirm rectification interval not exceeded.

templates.title: C-Check task package 1200 — CFR 25 lifelimited part status review
templates.description: Review LLP status (engine LLPs, MLG LLPs, pickle fork outboard chord), update tracker, plan next intervention windows. Per AMM 05-50.

templates.title: Towing event — gear pin install/remove and brake pressurization check
templates.description: Install MLG/NLG ground locks for tow, confirm System A accumulator pressure for parking brake, walk-around clearance check.

templates.title: Tug coupling damage — inspect NLG towbar fitting
templates.description: Following towing incident report: inspect NLG towbar attach point for cracks, deformation. Dye penetrant if any indication. Per AMM 09-10.

templates.title: Storage preparation — engine and APU preservation 7-day
templates.description: Apply preservation procedure to engines and APU per AMM 10-13 for short-term storage: oil system fogging, intake/exhaust covers, pitot covers, gear pin install.

templates.title: Return to service — post-storage system tests
templates.description: Remove preservation, run engine motoring, full hydraulic and pneumatic checks, refuel and water service. Confirm CDS BITE clean.

templates.title: Replace fuselage exit door placard (faded)
templates.description: Replace ARM/DISARM and OPEN sequence placard adjacent to door 2L per IPC. Check adhesive cure time.

templates.title: Repaint walkway markings on horizontal stab
templates.description: Touch up red walkway markings per livery std. Surface prep, mask, apply two coats of polyurethane paint.

templates.title: Replace cargo compartment loading limit placard
templates.description: Cargo compartment max load placard illegible — replace per AMM 11-30.

templates.title: Top up engine #1 oil reservoir
templates.description: Engine #1 oil quantity below MIN — service oil tank to FULL mark per AMM 12-13. Use only approved engine oil grade (MIL-PRF-23699).

templates.title: Top up engine #2 oil reservoir
templates.description: Engine #2 oil low. Service per AMM 12-13.

templates.title: Replenish APU oil tank
templates.description: APU oil quantity low — service to FULL per AMM 12-13-49. Honeywell APS family / GTCP85.

templates.title: Replenish hydraulic System A reservoir
templates.description: System A reservoir below MIN line. Replenish with Skydrol LD-4 per AMM 12-12. Note B737 reservoir sight gauge calibration with flap position.

templates.title: Replenish hydraulic System B reservoir
templates.description: System B reservoir replenish per AMM 12-12. Check pre-existing leak signs at EDP and EMP.

templates.title: Replenish standby hydraulic reservoir
templates.description: Standby hydraulic reservoir replenish. Smaller capacity — uses System B fluid type.

templates.title: Servicing potable water tank
templates.description: Refill potable water tank, sanitization check, drain low-point. Per AMM 12-14.

templates.title: Lavatory waste tank service and rinse
templates.description: Drain blue water, rinse, and pre-charge with disinfectant per OM lav servicing.

templates.title: Tire pressure check all gear
templates.description: Check and adjust nitrogen pressure on 4 MLG and 2 NLG tires. Document per AMM 12-15. NG tire pressure spec ~205 psi MLG.

templates.title: Engine oil sample for SOAP analysis
templates.description: Take routine oil sample from engine #1 for spectrometric oil analysis program. Bottle, label, ship to lab.

templates.title: Replace pack valve (PRSOV) #1
templates.description: Pack 1 PRSOV reported intermittent regulation, BITE message on previous flight. R/R PRSOV per AMM 21-26 task 400. Operational test after install.

templates.title: Pack 2 inoperative — troubleshoot per CDS message
templates.description: Pack 2 fault in cruise. Run BITE on pack temperature controller, check overheat sensor continuity, swap controller if no fault on bench. Cat C dispatch with FL250 limit per MMEL 21-51.

templates.title: Replace trim air modulating valve cabin zone FWD
templates.description: Forward zone temperature uncontrollable, trim air valve seized at mid-position. R/R per AMM 21-43.

templates.title: Outflow valve overhaul return — install and test
templates.description: Install overhauled OFV per AMM 21-31. Pressurization functional test on stand or run. B737 has single fwd-bottom outflow valve.

templates.title: Replace recirc fan — bearing noise
templates.description: Cabin recirc fan reported abnormal noise by cabin crew. Inspect, R/R fan assembly per AMM 21-58.

templates.title: Cabin pressure controller (CPC) BITE check
templates.description: Run BITE on CPC #1, capture fault history, swap with #2 if symptom follows controller.

templates.title: E/E bay cooling — replace forward outlet valve fan
templates.description: E/E cooling system fan inop per CDS warning. R/R blower per AMM 21-58.

templates.title: Cabin pressure leak suspected — door seal inspection
templates.description: Slow climb in cabin altitude reported. Inspect door 1L/1R/2L/2R seals plus tail cone seal for damage; replace damaged sections.

templates.title: Pack outlet temperature sensor replacement
templates.description: Pack outlet temp sensor erratic per BITE. R/R sensor.

templates.title: Replace Flight Control Computer (FCC) channel A
templates.description: FCC A reported intermittent autopilot disconnects. R/R LRU per AMM 22-11. Operational test single AP and dual AP CAT III.

templates.title: Autothrottle servo replacement
templates.description: A/T servo not responding to FMC commands. R/R per AMM 22-31.

templates.title: Mode Control Panel (MCP) backlight failure
templates.description: MCP backlight inop on F/O side. R/R MCP. Avionics shop test.

templates.title: Yaw damper failure — coupler shop replacement
templates.description: Yaw damper fail flag during cruise. Yaw damper coupler R/R per AMM 22-22. Note B737 has SMYD (Stall Management Yaw Damper) on NG.

templates.title: VHF #2 transceiver replacement
templates.description: VHF 2 reported by crew as unable to transmit. R/R transceiver per AMM 23-12. Bench test.

templates.title: CVR test fail — replace cockpit voice recorder
templates.description: Pre-flight CVR self-test failed. R/R CVR per AMM 23-71. Recording test post install.

templates.title: ACARS datalink intermittent — replace ATC/CMU
templates.description: ACARS messages dropping. R/R communications management unit per AMM 23-27.

templates.title: Captain audio control panel — switch failure
templates.description: Captain ACP comm select intermittent. R/R ACP per AMM 23-51.

templates.title: IDG #1 oil leak at quick-disconnect — drain and inspect
templates.description: Tech log report of oil under pylon. Inspect IDG QAD seal, drain residual oil, check oil quantity, leak test before next flight.

templates.title: IDG #2 disconnect — replace IDG
templates.description: Crew disconnected IDG 2 in flight after low oil pressure. Inspect IDG, R/R unit (forward QAD removal), bench test old.

templates.title: APU generator failure — replace
templates.description: APU gen offline; ETOPS dispatch impacted. R/R APU GCU and/or generator per AMM 24-22.

templates.title: Main battery capacity check (annual)
templates.description: Capacity test on main battery per AMM 24-31. If below 80% nameplate, replace.

templates.title: Static inverter replacement
templates.description: Static inverter BITE message. R/R per AMM 24-58.

templates.title: Bus tie breaker (BTB) sticking — replace
templates.description: BTB not auto-isolating during ground test. R/R BTB.

templates.title: External power receptacle — pin damage repair
templates.description: Ground crew reported damage at external power receptacle. Inspect pins, replace receptacle if pin bent/burnt. AMM 24-41.

templates.title: Replace pax seat cushion (cabin)
templates.description: Seat cushion 12C torn/burned. R/R cushion per IPC. Document.

templates.title: Galley oven not heating — replace heating element
templates.description: Aft galley oven 2 not reaching set temperature. Inspect, R/R heating element. AMM 25-31.

templates.title: Lavatory door latch repair
templates.description: Lav D door latch broken. R/R latch. Test from inside and out.

templates.title: Replace pax life vest — expired
templates.description: Pre-flight check found life vest under seat 8A expired. R/R life vest. Update equipment log.

templates.title: ELT battery replacement (life expired)
templates.description: ELT battery shows life expiry within 30 days. Pre-emptive replacement per AMM 25-65. Function test.

templates.title: Slide rebottle inspection — overdue check
templates.description: Door 1L escape slide bottle overdue 5-year hydrostatic. Send to slide shop for inspection and recharge.

templates.title: Cargo net replacement — fwd cargo
templates.description: Forward cargo net torn beyond repair limits. R/R per AMM 25-50.

templates.title: Engine fire detection loop A — fault BITE
templates.description: Engine 1 fire loop A BITE fault. Inspect loop continuity, replace damaged loop section per AMM 26-11.

templates.title: APU fire bottle pressure low — replace bottle
templates.description: APU fire bottle pressure below allowable per gauge. R/R bottle per AMM 26-25. Hydrostatic test certificate review.

templates.title: Lav D smoke detector false alarm — replace
templates.description: Repeated smoke alarm with no actual smoke. R/R smoke detector head, clean lens.

templates.title: Cargo compartment fire bottle 1 squib continuity check
templates.description: Pre-emptive check: continuity of fwd cargo fire bottle squib circuit. AMM 26-23.

templates.title: Engine 2 fire handle test — squib continuity
templates.description: Functional test of fire handle T-handle: arm switch, squib continuity, agent line continuity. Per AMM 26-22.

templates.title: Replace elevator feel computer
templates.description: Elevator feel computer BITE fault. R/R LRU per AMM 27-31. Operational test.

templates.title: Stab trim cutout switch — column actuated cutout fail
templates.description: Stab trim column cutout failed during functional test. R/R switch assembly per AMM 27-41. Critical for runaway stab protection.

templates.title: Trailing edge flap asymmetry — sensor replacement
templates.description: Flap asymmetry warning during ext/ret cycle. R/R asymmetry sensor per AMM 27-51. Rigging check.

templates.title: Spoiler / speedbrake actuator leak — R/R
templates.description: Spoiler 4 actuator leaking System A fluid. R/R actuator per AMM 27-61. Functional test.

templates.title: Aileron PCU servo seal replacement
templates.description: Aileron PCU showing slow response. Replace servo seal per AMM 27-11.

templates.title: Rudder PCU input rod adjustment
templates.description: Rudder pedal force out of limits during functional test. Adjust input rod per AMM 27-21. Re-test.

templates.title: Slat asymmetry transducer — R/R
templates.description: Leading edge slat asymmetry sensor BITE fault. R/R transducer per AMM 27-81.

templates.title: Stab trim motor replacement — primary
templates.description: Primary stab trim motor not responding. R/R motor assembly. Critical: confirm operates only via primary path before release.

templates.title: Flap track inspection — wear and corrosion (NG)
templates.description: T/E flap track #2 inspection per AMM 27-50: wear measurement at carriage rollers, corrosion check on track. NG-specific.

templates.title: Center tank boost pump replacement
templates.description: Center tank pump 1 low pressure light. R/R pump per AMM 28-21.

templates.title: Wing tank pump #1 outlet pressure low — R/R
templates.description: Left wing tank fwd pump output pressure below limits. R/R per AMM 28-22.

templates.title: Crossfeed valve manual operation check
templates.description: Routine functional test of crossfeed valve open/close timing per AMM 28-31.

templates.title: FQI channel calibration after sensor R/R
templates.description: Following pump R/R, FQI channel reading offset. Recalibrate via maintenance test.

templates.title: Refuel panel R-R coupling leak — replace seal
templates.description: Drip from refuel coupling during pressure refuel. R/R seal kit per AMM 28-46.

templates.title: Fuel tank wiring CDCCL inspection — center tank pump conduit (SFAR 88)
templates.description: Mandatory CDCCL inspection of center tank pump wiring conduit for chafing/insulation wear per FRM Airworthiness Limitations. Boeing reported insulation wear on pumps with >35,000 FH; arc events on >50,000 FH airframes.

templates.title: Fuel quantity probe replacement — center tank
templates.description: FQI center tank probe 3 short. Defuel partial, R/R probe per AMM 28-41. Refuel and recalibrate.

templates.title: Surge tank float valve check
templates.description: Inspect float valve operation in surge tank during refuel. AMM 28-15.

templates.title: Fuel scavenge jet pump cleaning (center tank)
templates.description: Center tank scavenge pump partial blockage suspected per fuel imbalance trend. Inspect, clean, reinstall per AMM 28-22.

templates.title: System A EDP replacement — case drain filter blocked indication
templates.description: System A EDP case drain bypass amber light. R/R EDP per AMM 29-11. Case drain filter sample for analysis.

templates.title: System B EMP replacement — overheat shutdown
templates.description: System B electric motor pump auto-shut on overheat repeatedly. R/R EMP per AMM 29-12.

templates.title: Standby hydraulic pump test fail — R/R
templates.description: Standby pump did not pressurize during pre-flight test. R/R pump per AMM 29-21. Standby system functional test.

templates.title: System A reservoir pressurization drop — bleed line check
templates.description: Sys A reservoir not pressurizing on engine start. Inspect bleed pressurization line, check air pressure regulator. AMM 29-11.

templates.title: System A/B PTU rudder operation — functional test
templates.description: PTU between A and B for rudder operation tested per AMM 29-31 after suspect rudder feel asymmetry.

templates.title: Hydraulic line leak inspection — leading edge wing
templates.description: Drip noted under wing root. Inspect leading edge slat actuator hyd lines, find leak source, replace damaged hose section.

templates.title: Hydraulic filter element replacement — both systems
templates.description: Routine 3000FH replacement of System A and B return/pressure filter elements per AMM 29-11/29-12.

templates.title: Quick disconnect (QAD) leak — System B EDP
templates.description: Drip at QAD of System B EDP. R/R QAD seal kit. Functional and leak test.

templates.title: Wing anti-ice valve sticking — R/R
templates.description: Wing anti-ice valve LH not opening on command. R/R valve per AMM 30-11. Functional test.

templates.title: Engine TAI valve actuator — slow operation
templates.description: Engine 2 TAI valve slow to open per BITE. R/R actuator per AMM 30-21.

templates.title: Pitot probe heater element open — R/R probe
templates.description: Capt pitot probe heat warning. Element ohms infinite. R/R pitot probe per AMM 30-31. Note AOA sensor handling caution per FAA AOA bulletin (relevant to MCAS).

templates.title: Windshield wiper park position adjustment
templates.description: Wiper not parking in correct position on shutoff. Adjust limit switch per AMM 30-42.

templates.title: TAT probe heater fault — R/R probe
templates.description: TAT indication frozen at 0C in cruise — heater failed. R/R probe.

templates.title: Replace DFDR — annual readout fail
templates.description: Annual FDR readout shop test failed several parameters. R/R DFDR per AMM 31-31.

templates.title: CDS Display Unit (DU) — pixel failure
templates.description: F/O outboard DU has dead pixel cluster bottom right. R/R DU per AMM 31-50.

templates.title: Master caution annunciator bulb replacement
templates.description: Master caution lamp dim — replace bulb per IPC.

templates.title: Standby instrument battery R/R (life expired)
templates.description: Integrated standby flight display battery time expired. R/R per AMM 31-65.

templates.title: MLG tire change — wear-out
templates.description: Right outboard MLG tire below allowable groove depth. R/R tire per AMM 32-45. Wheel inspection on remove.

templates.title: Brake unit replacement — wear pin flush
templates.description: Brake unit #2 wear pin flush with housing. R/R brake assy per AMM 32-42. Bedding-in run-up.

templates.title: Anti-skid valve replacement — wheel #3
templates.description: Anti-skid wheel 3 not modulating per BITE. R/R anti-skid valve.

templates.title: Pickle fork outboard chord crack inspection (AD 2019-20-08)
templates.description: Mandatory NDT inspection of pickle fork outboard chord on B737 NG airframes per FAA AD 2019-20-08. Aircraft accumulated >22,600 cycles. Eddy current at attach frame STA 663.75. NG-specific. Cracks found 5% of first 500 inspected; affected airframes grounded.

templates.title: Pickle fork crack found — installation of repair fitting (AD 2019-20-08)
templates.description: Confirmed crack indication on pickle fork attach frame. Install OEM-approved repair fitting per Boeing SB. Heavy structural job; aircraft grounded until completion.

templates.title: Nose wheel steering metering valve adjustment
templates.description: NWS deadband out of spec per ground steering check. Adjust metering valve per AMM 32-51.

templates.title: Gear retract test — main gear sequencing
templates.description: Gear swing on jacks: verify retract/extend sequence, door operation, uplock/downlock per AMM 32-32.

templates.title: Trunnion pin lubrication — MLG (1500 FH)
templates.description: Routine grease application to MLG trunnion bearings per AMM 12-21. NG configuration.

templates.title: Brake temperature sensor replacement — wheel #4
templates.description: BTM channel 4 reading offset. R/R brake temp sensor.

templates.title: Alternate gear extension manual handle test (gravity)
templates.description: Functional check of manual gear extension handle and gravity drop sequence per AMM 32-30. MEL B item per MMEL B-737 32-30.

templates.title: NLG shock strut nitrogen recharge
templates.description: NLG strut extension below servicing chart. Refill with hyd fluid (Skydrol) and nitrogen per AMM 32-21.

templates.title: Landing light bulb #2 — R/R
templates.description: Right landing light inop. R/R bulb per IPC. Function test.

templates.title: Strobe (anti-collision) light wing tip — bulb R/R
templates.description: Left wing tip strobe inop. R/R bulb.

templates.title: Cabin emergency light battery pack replacement
templates.description: Emergency light battery pack annual capacity test failed. R/R battery pack.

templates.title: Cockpit dome light dimmer — switch fault
templates.description: Cockpit dome light dimmer not regulating. R/R dimmer module.

templates.title: Logo light bulb R/R (vertical stab)
templates.description: Logo light inop on inspection. R/R bulb.

templates.title: ADIRU/IRS #2 align fail — R/R
templates.description: IRS 2 fails align in 10 minutes. R/R IRS LRU per AMM 34-12. Realign and BITE check.

templates.title: Weather radar transceiver R/R — image freeze
templates.description: WX radar image freezes intermittently. R/R radar transceiver per AMM 34-43.

templates.title: TCAS computer R/R — TA/RA inhibit fault
templates.description: TCAS computer flagging TA/RA inhibit. R/R per AMM 34-45.

templates.title: EGPWS database update
templates.description: Periodic EGPWS database load update via PCMCIA/USB per OEM bulletin.

templates.title: ATC transponder #2 mode S report fault — R/R
templates.description: Transponder 2 not reporting Mode S correctly. R/R per AMM 34-57. Required for RVSM.

templates.title: AOA sensor inspection — handling damage check (post tow)
templates.description: Following tow event near AOA vane, FAA bulletin requires inspection for handling damage. Inspect vane freedom, signal output. Critical for MCAS on MAX; also relevant to NG stall warning.

templates.title: AOA sensor R/R — signal disagree (MAX)
templates.description: AOA disagree alert per CDS following first flight. R/R AOA vane per AMM 34-23. Re-test MCAS arming logic per Boeing SB-MAX-FCC. MAX-specific.

templates.title: Crew O2 cylinder pressure recharge
templates.description: Crew O2 cylinder below 1500 psi at pre-flight. Recharge per AMM 35-11.

templates.title: Pax oxygen mask drop test — row 14 fail to drop
templates.description: Periodic mask drop functional test. Row 14 failed to drop. Inspect actuator, R/R if necessary per AMM 35-21.

templates.title: Portable O2 bottle pressure check (cabin)
templates.description: Routine pressure check on all 4 portable cabin O2 bottles. Recharge any below limit.

templates.title: Engine bleed valve sticking — R/R PRSOV
templates.description: Eng 1 bleed PRSOV not closing on overpressure. R/R valve per AMM 36-11.

templates.title: Crossbleed (isolation) valve sticking — R/R
templates.description: Crossbleed valve slow to close after engine start. R/R valve.

templates.title: Bleed leak detection loop fault — replace section
templates.description: Loop A fault on engine 2 strut. Inspect, R/R loop section per AMM 36-21.

templates.title: Precooler outlet temperature sensor R/R
templates.description: Precooler temp sensor reading out of range. R/R sensor.

templates.title: Vacuum waste system blockage — fwd lav
templates.description: Fwd lav not flushing per cabin crew report. Inspect line, clear blockage at vacuum generator.

templates.title: Potable water heater element R/R
templates.description: Aft galley water heater not heating. R/R heating element.

templates.title: Cabin PA amplifier R/R
templates.description: PA system intermittent — R/R PA amplifier per AMM 44-21.

templates.title: Cabin interphone station mid — handset replacement
templates.description: Mid interphone handset broken. R/R handset.

templates.title: EFB mounting bracket repair (Class 2)
templates.description: Captain EFB mounting bracket loose. Inspect, tighten, replace bracket if cracked.

templates.title: APU start failure — investigate ECU fault
templates.description: APU start failed: hot start indication. Run BITE on ECU, inspect EGT thermocouple, fuel control schedule. Honeywell APS3200/131-9 family.

templates.title: APU oil leak at accessory gearbox — seal R/R
templates.description: Visible oil drip at APU AGB. Inspect seal, R/R if necessary. AMM 49-90.

templates.title: APU bleed valve actuator R/R
templates.description: APU bleed not modulating per pneumatic demand. R/R bleed valve actuator per AMM 49-22.

templates.title: APU fire bottle squib continuity check
templates.description: Routine functional test of APU fire bottle squib continuity. AMM 49-61.

templates.title: APU oil filter element R/R (bypass indication)
templates.description: APU oil filter bypass amber on. R/R oil filter element, sample debris if any.

templates.title: Cargo door indication switch R/R
templates.description: Aft cargo door unsafe indication remained on after closure. R/R proximity switch.

templates.title: Pax door 1L slide bottle pressure check
templates.description: Routine slide bottle pressure check during turnaround. AMM 52-00.

templates.title: MAX 9 mid-exit door plug inspection (AD 2024-02-51)
templates.description: Mandatory inspection of mid-exit door plug per FAA AD 2024-02-51 following Alaska 1282 in-flight separation Jan 2024. Visual inspect 4 retention bolts and stop pads, torque verification, document. MAX 9 specific. MEL Cat A (operator-defined interval, often per-flight check).

templates.title: MAX 9 door plug — retention bolt R/R per AD
templates.description: Following inspection per AD 2024-02-51, retention bolt found loose. Remove plug, inspect stop pads, install new bolts to torque per Boeing SB. MAX 9 specific.
partsRequired: Door plug retention bolt set (P/N BA-737-DP-BOLT)

templates.title: Fuselage skin lightning strike inspection
templates.description: Crew reported lightning strike near aft fuselage. Inspect skin per AMM 53-00, look for entry/exit points, bonding straps, NDT if indication.

templates.title: Belly fairing minor dent — repair scheme
templates.description: Ground equipment strike dent on belly fairing aft. Damage within allowable per SRM. Stop-drill if cracking, blend repair.

templates.title: Engine fan cowl latch inspection — corrosion
templates.description: Fan cowl latch shows corrosion per visual. Disassemble, clean, lubricate, re-test latch operation.

templates.title: Pylon attach bolt torque check (sample)
templates.description: Periodic structural check on pylon attach bolts per Boeing SB. Sampled bolts to spec torque.

templates.title: Cockpit windshield heat fault — pane #2
templates.description: Capt windshield heat overheat trip on ground. R/R windshield heat controller.

templates.title: Cabin window pane delamination — R/R inner pane
templates.description: Inner pane on row 12 left shows delamination spots. R/R inner pane per AMM 56-21.

templates.title: Engine 1 fan blade lubrication / dovetail inspection (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: Per CFM56-7B AMM 71/72: routine fan blade dovetail lube and visual inspection during line check. NG-specific engine procedure.

templates.title: Engine 2 nacelle drain pattern inspection
templates.description: Inspect nacelle drains per AMM 71. Look for fluid color/source — fuel/oil/hydraulic — to identify upstream leak.

templates.title: CFM56-7B HPT borescope inspection (BSI per task 72-00-00-200)
templates.description: Periodic BSI of HPT blades per CFM TASK 72-00-00-200-807-F00. Look for blade tip cracks, leading edge erosion, TBC spalling. Reference GEK 119346. Rate of EGT margin loss 11-15C in first 1000 EFC.

templates.title: LEAP-1B HPC blade BSI
templates.description: Periodic BSI of HPC blades on LEAP-1B per CFM AMM. MAX-specific. Look for FOD damage, blade tip wear.

templates.title: CFM56-7B HPT blade replacement set (off-wing)
templates.description: Engine sent to shop for HPT blade replacement set due to EGT margin exceedance. Heavy maintenance, off-wing job.

templates.title: Engine FOD inspection after bird strike report
templates.description: Crew reported bird strike at takeoff. Inspect engine inlet, fan blade leading edges per AMM 72. Borescope if any indication.

templates.title: LEAP-1B Load Reduction Device (LRD) software update (per NTSB rec 2025)
templates.description: Per NTSB urgent recommendation following Southwest 737-8 cabin smoke event Dec 2023: incorporate Boeing/CFM software mod that closes bleed valve faster on LRD activation. MAX-specific.

templates.title: EEC channel A swap — engine 2 (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: EEC ch A faulty per BITE; swap to ch B governing. Plan ch A LRU R/R at next opportunity. AMM 73-22.

templates.title: EEC LRU replacement (LEAP-1B)
templates.description: EEC dual-channel BITE ground fault. R/R EEC LRU per AMM 73-22. MAX-specific.

templates.title: Fuel filter element R/R — engine 1
templates.description: Fuel filter bypass amber latched. R/R filter element per AMM 73-31. Sample for analysis.

templates.title: HMU (Hydromechanical Unit) leak — engine 2 CFM56-7B
templates.description: Fuel leak at HMU/MEC body. R/R HMU per AMM 73-21.

templates.title: Ignition exciter R/R — engine 1 ch A
templates.description: Ignition channel A no fire on start attempt. R/R ignition exciter per AMM 74-21.

templates.title: Igniter plug R/R — engine 2 ch B
templates.description: Igniter plug no spark per shop test. R/R igniter plug.

templates.title: 8th stage bleed valve actuator R/R (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: 8th stage bleed valve sticking per BITE. R/R actuator per AMM 75-31. NG-specific bleed scheduling.

templates.title: VBV (Variable Bleed Valve) actuator R/R (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: VBV actuator out of schedule per EEC. R/R actuator. CFM56-7B specific.

templates.title: VSV (Variable Stator Vane) actuator R/R
templates.description: VSV scheduling fault per EEC ground test. R/R actuator. Applies to CFM56-7B and LEAP-1B with variant differences.

templates.title: N1 vibration sensor R/R — engine 1
templates.description: N1 vibration channel reading offset. R/R accelerometer per AMM 77-11.

templates.title: EGT thermocouple harness R/R — engine 2 (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: EGT one channel reading low. R/R EGT harness per AMM 77-21. CFM56-7B specific.

templates.title: N2 sensor R/R — engine 1
templates.description: N2 indication erratic. R/R N2 speed sensor.

templates.title: Thrust reverser cowl translating sleeve actuator R/R
templates.description: T/R translating sleeve actuator slow extending. R/R per AMM 78-31. Functional test on ground.

templates.title: Thrust reverser deactivation — engine 2 (MEL dispatch)
templates.description: T/R failed during landing rollout. Deactivate per MMEL 78-31, locked retracted. Cat B dispatch with landing penalty.

templates.title: Engine exhaust nozzle — heat damage inspection (LEAP-1B)
templates.description: Visual inspection of exhaust nozzle exit for thermal distress, cracking. LEAP-1B specific exhaust geometry.

templates.title: Engine oil filter element R/R — engine 1
templates.description: Engine oil filter bypass indication. R/R filter element. Send filter and chip detector for lab analysis.

templates.title: Magnetic chip detector inspection — engine 2
templates.description: Routine chip detector pull, magnetic particle inspection. If significant, engine borescope and SOAP.

templates.title: Oil pressure transmitter R/R — engine 1
templates.description: Oil pressure transmitter reading erratic. R/R transmitter.

templates.title: Oil quantity transmitter R/R
templates.description: Oil quantity indication frozen at one value. R/R transmitter per AMM 79-32.

templates.title: Starter air valve R/R — slow open on engine 2 start
templates.description: SAV slow to open on start, hot start risk. R/R per AMM 80-11.

templates.title: Engine starter R/R — engine 1 (CFM56-7B)
templates.description: Pneumatic starter air leak from drive seal. R/R starter per AMM 80-11.
